ORDINANCE e

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all the B3-2 Community Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on
Map No. 4-H in the area bounded by:

the public alley next north of West 21* St; a line 75.0 feet next east of and parallel to South
Hoyne Avenue; West 21* St; and a line 50.0 feet next east of and parallel to South Hoyne
Avenue

to those of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Address: 2052 West 21* Street
